role: Separate nonauthor review. No production, tests, CI or shared documentation authored or modified. No Cargo/build/commit executed.
decision: No blocker found in the reviewed production source, portable CLI artifact or frozen installed Python API. Remaining broader CI/platform/native/browser/Blender executions must retain their own artifact-bound evidence; this review does not claim those executions.

static_observations.observation: MeshPlacement request resolves once into private ResolvedPlacement before source binding. Quaternion finite/range/norm admission, normalization, ENU rotation, declared cartographic frame and conservative exact magnitude comparison belong to this pure owner.

General TwoSum grow-expansion carries at most five terms for four nonnegative components and negative cap. Individual cap guards prevent overflow; final most significant nonzero expansion term decides exact sign. Independent Decimal90 verifies cap is greatest admitted f64 below the real budget.

Both archive extensions use one writer with explicit root matrix and transform-free children. Report and manifest use the same resolved transform. No placement choice enters leaf/resource encoding; bounds use B-space and content runtime applies B once.

Core request and placement resolution plus platform admission precede binding. Existing Attempt checkpoints, fallible observations, workspace ownership, staging/sealing/publication path remain explicit. New placement adds no source alias, callback or publication bypass.

Final oracle imports prior independent local PBR/resource readers through a strict request expectation seam; it checks local source truth separately and uses Decimal/Hamilton forward arithmetic for world truth. Prior local bounds checks were strengthened from epsilon to exact containment. Viewer uses independent fixed world targets/cameras and keeps presentation modelMatrix identity; sensitive changed-root controls are explicit.

tests/mesh_archive.rs adds 42 real API conversions from 21 previously authored frozen Decimal/cardinal anchor strings, identity and independently frozen rational Hamilton rotation rows. Expected translation uses fixed B(offset)=[5,-11,7], verifies homogeneous row, and evaluates target-native trig/root generation against frozen references. This review inspected the source; it did not execute Cargo or claim any CI OS result.

Final resource probe uses one fresh stdlib worker per case that never generates fixtures or hashes binaries. It records launcher RSS/HWM and explicitly distinguishes raw wait4 child high water including launch floor from sampled converter VmHWM. Original large-parent-HWM accounting is superseded; sampled observations still cannot establish universal/transient peaks or asymptotic overhead.

Unique candidate names avoid source/output alias false negatives in the shared oracle. Partial CLI arity is now asserted as pre-producer Clap usage transport rather than a core typed InvalidRequest. CI resource invocation supplies mandatory --binary-sha256; artifact digests remain explicit.

executed_proof.format_report: Returned CLI report equals conversion.json and root_transform equals emitted root matrix; local/placed GLB bytes unchanged; .3tz and .3dtiles.zip member bytes equal.

proof_limits: Own executed runtime proof covers the frozen portable CLI and Linux installed CPython3.14.7 API; it does not include native/browser/Blender or non-Unix execution.
Own fixture has POSITION only; authored PBR/resource truth requires separate evidence.
No universal geodetic/platform/transcendental or renderer precision proof; bounded sampled arithmetic cases establish these executions only.
Initial handcrafted fixture omitted required POSITION min/max and was correctly refused; reviewer corrected the fixture. This was a harness defect, not a production defect.
Linux installed CPython3.14.7 ABI3 extension only.
Python cancellation evidence uses KeyboardInterrupt/SIGINT delivered during callbacks; public Python API does not expose direct RunControl reuse.
Nested calls prove separate adapter-created controls, not reuse of one Rust RunControl.
No platform/native/renderer/Blender execution in this installed-API extension review.

checks: Handcrafted placed source matches independent decoded-node truth, Decimal world target, world OBB and manifest/report parity.

No retained workspace or staging files; extension matches both frozen wheel member and installed module before and after execution.
